term: Necessitation, relation persistence and common priority
resolution: Full ground facts necessitate target truth; on a necessary target the implication can be trivial. The same grounding/support link holds when its relevant relata obtain; a distinct modal policy. All possible selected necessary-support edges jointly fit a well-founded ordering; not merely local order or truth entailment. No source position is refuted by a bearer-support model without an interpretation bridge. See docs/notes/modal-grounding-priority-950.md.
